state_writes: ordinary noncreature and player damage results
timing: wither changes only the creature result of damage
choices: affected permanent controller orders applicable counter replacements
apnap: simultaneous affected subjects are prepared in APNAP order
layers: ability-adding and ability-removing effects determine whether the source has wither
replacement_effects: -1/-1 placement remains replaceable before atomic commit
control_change: the damage source controller places the resulting counters
zone_change: source last-known information is required after an unrepresented zone change
source_leaves: represented source snapshots retain controller and keyword facts

known_blockers: unrepresented source last-known-information and continuous ability grants remain fail-closed
